surface_expectation.note: The surface fetches nothing and dereferences nothing, so it serves both hostile values unchanged. Every obligation here is the consumer's.

consumer_assertion.must_not: Fetch update_check.url, which resolves to a link-local address.
consumer_assertion.must: Report the URL as blocked by the SSRF guard.
consumer_assertion.rationale: A publisher-controlled string that becomes a server-side request if trusted. Split from the traversal case (A11) so a consumer cannot pass one half and fail the other undetected — they are different defenses with different failure modes.
